BiblicalUsage: Azad is the Aramaic word for firm — the king's decree is certain. Nebuchadnezzar tells the wise men the thing is gone from him, and the word is firm: if they do not show the dream, they will be cut in pieces. The king's word, once spoken, does not bend.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe earthly kings love to make their word firm, but only God's word is truly unbreakable — and his is the one I trust.
